g.text: Customer Activity Analytics — illustrative functional use cases
Completed-system precondition for protected use cases.
MUST_HAVE priority means authentication is activated after
the mandatory centre; it is not an R1 acceptance gate.
CARD, PAYMENT and CRYPTO are specializations
UML Package = logical namespace/grouping of coherent use cases.
System boundary = subject to which the use cases apply; visual containment
does not replace package ownership. Requirement IDs are traceability labels,
not Requirement elements embedded in this UML use-case view.
